content.title: Configure dual-format TypeDoc generation
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/docs-generation.md

CTO has already updated: .gitignore, library-release access rules, and release workflow paths.

Your task:
1. Update typedoc.json — remove the 'out' field (output path will be specified per invocation)
2. Update package.json scripts:
   - docs:html — TypeDoc HTML output to ../../docs/html
   - docs:md — TypeDoc Markdown output to ../../docs/md (use typedoc-plugin-markdown with conciseness flags: hideBreadcrumbs, hidePageHeader, etc.)
   - docs — runs both docs:html and docs:md
   - docs:check — validates without generating (keep as-is with --emit none)
3. Verify: run 'bun run docs' and confirm both docs/html/ and docs/md/ are generated at repo root
4. Verify: run 'bun run quality' — all gates must still pass
5. Clean up the old packages/library/docs-html/ directory (no longer needed)

Read the spec at .agentic/specs/docs-generation.md for full requirements and acceptance criteria.
